scope.capability: One voluntary switch from a living wild-battle MAIN boundary after four PP-spending turns without enemy HP decrease, or no usable move. Disposable WIN qualification only.
limitations: Threshold does not identify misses, immunity, status setup or multi-turn moves.
Existing reserve screening does not guarantee survival on entry.
One switch only; second stall is a retained failure.
Fainted forced switching, move learning, same-battler move replacement and cross-venue cartridge settlement remain unqualified.

review.mode: app, read-only contract review; not a source audit
accepted: No-HP progress is a heuristic, not causal diagnosis.
rejected: Existing reserve ranking already screens level, HP and status; it does not admit the cited level-3 versus level-28 example.
A Run fallback would broaden the frozen disposable WIN contract; retain second-stall failure.
review.final_verdict: No remaining concrete P0/P1 design defects.
